label: Good
corporate_parent: BSH Home Appliances Corporation — subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH

induction_system.description: FlexInduction — two zones electronically bridge via relay logic to accommodate large cookware. Firmware-controlled, physical coils are dual smaller units side-by-side. 4-channel inverter architecture (standard complexity).

control_interface.description: Touch control panel with slider interface. Not full touchscreen like Thermador Freedom.
control_interface.known_failure_pattern: EEVBlog-documented: 74HC4053 triple 2-channel analog multiplexer IC failure. Touch inputs read through these ICs; failure causes unresponsive controls. Also: conductive foam-to-PCB pad thermal cycling degradation, cold solder joints on resistors.
control_interface.repair_note: Manufacturer standard procedure is full control board replacement. Component-level repair requires advanced SMD soldering skills and voids warranty.

performance_evidence.watts_detail: 3700W max — standard tier, not top-tier. Suitable for most cooking but below Thermador Freedom 4600W.
performance_evidence.flex_induction: Two zones bridge electronically for large cookware — practical feature for griddles and stock pots
performance_evidence.boil_time: good — competitive with premium induction but below Freedom's PowerBoost

yale_service_rate.context: BEST in entire induction category. 1.7% vs Thermador 4.9% vs category average ~3.8%. Hypothesis confirmed: simpler 4-channel electronics vs Freedom's 8-16 channels = fewer failure points.

common_failures.touch_control: 4053 multiplexer IC failure is the documented pattern. Advanced electronics community has mapped the failure mode.
common_failures.power_electronics: IGBT and power board failures are possible but rare at 1.7% service rate. Simpler architecture = more reliable.

service_network.description: BSH parts universally stocked. Every independent appliance technician can work on BSH products. Strongest parts ecosystem in induction category.

parts_availability.description: BSH parts available via E-Nr model number lookup through official BSH channels and authorized distributors. Shared platform means parts interchangeability across BSH brands.

control_board.notes: Despite documented 4053 multiplexer pattern, overall 1.7% service rate proves real-world reliability. Pattern affects a small percentage of units.

platform_disclosure.bsh_shared_platform: MANDATORY: Bosch 800 shares BSH induction platform core with Thermador and Gaggenau. Same E.G.O. coils, same Infineon IGBTs, same Schott CERAN glass. Key difference: Bosch uses simpler 4-channel fixed/flex zone architecture. Thermador Freedom's full-surface 48-56 element array is unique hardware — NOT on Bosch.
platform_disclosure.reliability_insight: The BSH platform sharing explains WHY Bosch (1.7%) is significantly more reliable than Thermador (4.9%) — same base platform, but Freedom adds 4x the electronic complexity.

S: Yale Appliance — induction service rate 1.7% (best in category)
